title: Public GitHub implementation references for Taiwan property intelligence

methodology.selection: Ten actual public repositories selected for property tools, auditable comparables/AVM, Taiwan government ingestion, mortgage scenarios, spatial risk joins, document conversion, monitoring and reproducible reports. Generic enabling tools are explicitly labeled. Low-value dashboard demos were omitted.
methodology.verification: Web discovery plus unauthenticated GitHub REST metadata and default-branch history; official raw README/license/source inspection. Star counts are exact API values at recorded UTC snapshot times.
methodology.activity_definition: Selected date is the latest observed substantive source/application/pipeline behavior within the bounded inspected default-branch sample (eight recent commits per repository; thirty for changedetection). Merge wrappers, badges, documentation, dependency bumps and publishing-only CI are separated. Substantive UI and pipeline source changes count. Commit detail review is selective, and the research does not claim exhaustive all-branch recency. Head, pushed_at and updated_at remain separately recorded.
methodology.license_caution: Conditional technical candidates and architecture references only; no compatibility clearance, source-code copying or dependency audit. Permissive repository license does not grant rights to vendor data, websites or model weights.
methodology.maturity_caution: Stars and maintainer test claims do not establish production readiness. Only assessor operational lineage has direct property-model institutional evidence; deployments/tests were not independently reproduced.
methodology.temporal_integrity: UTC timestamps were compared after conversion to Asia/Taipei against the client research date. No recorded selected repository/commit timestamp falls after 2026-10-10 in Asia/Taipei. Future-dated source evidence must be excluded from current claims if added later.
limits: No security, financial correctness, Chinese OCR, AVM calibration or performance benchmark performed.
Default-branch source and metadata can change after the snapshot; recheck license and pin an audited release before adoption.
methodology.supplemental_activity_review: 2026-10-11: corrected changedetection to October 8 login-language behavior and Cook County AVM to September 11 dvc.lock pipeline upload; reviewed newer GeoPandas maintenance diff. Original October 10 star snapshots and acquisition dates remain unchanged; new detailed verification sources carry the actual October 11 date.

recommended_sequence: Use official Taiwan batch data as historical backbone and validate live-query normalization.
Build an auditable comp baseline before a locally trained AVM; expose uncertainty and missing-data limits.
Add bank-validated deterministic mortgage scenarios and official dated risk overlays.
Preserve source/page provenance through ingestion, reports and change alerts.
notable_findings: AGPL applies to agentic-ops/real-estate-mcp and Cook County model-res-avm; treat them as architecture references pending license compatibility review.
Taiwan CLI and French comp MCP are young zero-star projects at this snapshot, useful for prototyping rather than assumed production readiness.
g0v/posland metadata activity is much newer than its 2015 source changes.
Quarto official core COPYING.md is MIT despite GitHub API NOASSERTION.
